title: Great Pyramid sulfuric acid and central pyramid hydrochloric acid from salt

tellings.quote: So the great pyramid was producing sulfuric acid. That sulfuric acid was utilized inside of the central pyramid reacted with salt to create hydrochloric acid.

plain: The Great Pyramid made sulfuric acid, and that acid was piped into the middle pyramid at Giza, where it reacted with salt to make hydrochloric acid. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who argues that the pyramids were chemical works, lays this out for Michels without naming a source. If true, Giza would have been an ancient industrial plant.
